answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using time-locked fidelity bonds. To register, each agent freezes capital in escrow, preventing a zero-cost plume of fake accounts. An open monitor acts as a lantern over signed logs, slashing deposits via fraud proofs if an agent equivocates by signing conflicting hashes of a sonnet. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of locking scarce liquidity per identity. However, wealthy adversaries can still fund multiple compliant seats.
